LanguageData.FalloutMech_Mark1Robotics.label: Mr. Handy Mark 1 ingénierie
LanguageData.FalloutMech_Mark1Robotics.description: Adapt the rugged General Atomics Mark 1 châssis to RimWorld mechanitor control systems. This unlocks the civilian Mr. Handy-Mark 1, a costly but versatile construction, maintenance and cargo mécanoïde.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_Mark1Military.label: Mark 1 militaire conversion
LanguageData.FalloutMech_Mark1Military.description: Reinforce the Mark 1 châssis and integrate a double machine-pistolet system, a circular scie and a lourd pince. This unlocks the militaire Mr. Handy-Mark 1.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_NexGenRobotics.label: de nouvelle génération Mr. Handy ingénierie
LanguageData.FalloutMech_NexGenRobotics.description: Adapt the compact tri-optic Mister Handy châssis to high-tier mechanitor systems. This unlocks the standard de nouvelle génération Mr. Handy, a costly but intégrée household, workshop and cleaning assistant.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_NexGenLaborStandardization.d: Standardize the de nouvelle génération Mister Handy plateforme for a low-cost agricole travail model built around a regular subcore. This unlocks Mr. Farmhand, a crop and plant-cutting assistant with reduced high-end capability.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_MisterOrderly.label: Mister Orderly
LanguageData.FalloutMech_MisterOrderly.description: Develop a high-subcore médical and laboratoire derivative of the de nouvelle génération Mister Handy plateforme. This unlocks Mister Orderly, a clinical assistant capable of doctoring, recherche, hauling, firefighting and cleaning. It can conduct technological recherche at recherche benches. It also performs crafting work, including medicine production and stonecutting.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_MissNanny.label: Miss Nanny
LanguageData.FalloutMech_MissNanny.description: Refine the de nouvelle génération Mister Handy plateforme into a personality-enabled childcare, médical and social-care assistant. This unlocks Miss Nanny, a high-subcore domestique mécanoïde capable of doctoring, wardening, childcare, hauling, firefighting and cleaning.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_MisterGutsy.label: Mr. Gutsy
LanguageData.FalloutMech_MisterGutsy.description: Adapt the de nouvelle génération Mister Handy châssis for dedicated militaire service with léger armor, a 10mm mitraillette, an bras-mounted lance-flammes and a reinforced pince. This unlocks Mr. Gutsy.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_GutsyLieutenant.label: Lieutenant Mr. Gutsy
LanguageData.FalloutMech_GutsyLieutenant.description: Reinforce the compact Mr. Gutsy châssis and adapt an automatique AER-pattern laser fusil for sustained precision fire. This unlocks Lieutenant Mr. Gutsy.
LanguageData.FalloutMech_GutsyColonel.label: Colonel Mr. Gutsy
LanguageData.FalloutMech_GutsyColonel.description: Integrate a high subcore, avancé militaire armor and a command-grade focalisé laser fusil into the Mr. Gutsy plateforme. This unlocks Colonel Mr. Gutsy.
